notes.title: MAJOR: 0.7.90 Remix Update and more!
notes.content:
Update 0.7.90 is the first major update for Drink 'Em! This update includes Remix Games. All information is provided below.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/680608974d58d3d708cf464aa91c231350aa9dac.png[/img]

[h1]Major Updates[/h1]
[b][u]Remix Games[/u][/b]
A Remix game takes current mini games and modifies them. They can be any of the following:
different level or version
combination of 2 more more mini games
challenge that is converted into a competitive game

[b][u]Shop Items[/u][/b]
5 new shop items to customize your characters.

[b][u]4 New Challenges[/u][/b]
With all of this new content, we provided more challenges to get more tabs for the new stuff!

[h1]Minor Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased tab pickup tab count in mini games from 2-4 to 4-8.
[*] Increased tie check time from 0.5s to 1s.
[*] Fixed glitch where in Ball Drop, the ball could get stuck at the bottom.
[*] Fixed Party Mask shop item from not previously working.
[*] Fixed glitch that caused stats to give crazy amounts of take drinks.
[*] Made mini game selection 3 column for easier browsing of games.
[*] Opening Feedback menu will reset the text from previous message.
[/list]

Hope you guys enjoy the new update! If you find any issues or want to give feedback, please do so! Also, we are open for recommendations on what content you guys' would like to have more of: Characters, mini games, challenges etc. Let us know and we can possibly make that higher priority.

Thanks!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/1d4f9e06dced0b9fae21837d5e61a06591123efa.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/2e0c455df4ec1ac6238cfd4dc41e28497897465c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Coming Soon: Remix Games and more!
notes.content:
Hello all! 

Instead of giving small updates, we have been working on the next major update, 0.7.90. This will include a new type of mini games called “Remix Games”. There will be 6 new remix mini games. It will also include more store content, more challenges and some bug fixes! Save up some of your tabs to make sure you can get all of the new content that will be in the store! This update will be coming next week, along with all of the info on the big update!

[h1]Remix Games[/h1]
A Remix game takes current mini games and modifies them. They can be any of the following:
[list]
[*] different level or version
[*] combination of 2 more more mini games
[*] challenge that is converted into a competitive game
[/list]

This opens up many more possibilities for games! As more normal mini games come out, more Remix mini games will be available as well! If you really enjoy a particular challenge, let us know and we can make it into a Remix game for competitive play.

Thanks!

notes.title: Drink 'Em Update!
notes.content:
[h1]New Name: 
Drink 'Em![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/667b3396d64b5ac78dd84ea9a8ef6833434059fe.png[/img]

We are proud to announce that we have decided to change our name to Drink 'Em. While we liked Drink Inc., it was a very early on name that we didn't have a great feel for. While we are still in the early stages, we have decided to switch it up, get a new logo, and make the name mean more of what the game entails! In this update, all of the content will be switched to Drink 'Em!

[h1]Upcoming News[/h1]
[list]
[*] There will be a Drink 'Em Sale starting tomorrow for 1 week! Get the game 50% off. 
[*] Remix games are coming soon. Be ready for a bunch of new mini games to play!
[*] Demo on the xbox will be made public very soon! It will also feature 8 players as well.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.2 Added Profiles
notes.content:
With this next update, you know longer need to remake your character after each game. Simply create a profile, ready up, and it will save everything from the last time you played!

CHANGES
-Added Profiles. 
-Added Profiles page. This is currently only there to allow you to remove and change a profile name. In the future, it will also show stats.

COMING UP
Stats
Each profile will also have stats. Ex) how many times you died, how many drinks taken etc. Let us know if you have any stats you would like recorded. If it isn't too crazy of a stat, we would love to add it.

Let us know what you like and do not like to help us improve the game! Any reviews on Steam are also appreciated. Hope you guys all enjoy!

notes.title: 0.7.1 XInput and Keyboard Controls
notes.content:
We have been having some users have issues connecting controllers to the game. This is a big issue as Drink Inc. is meant for using controllers and local play. Update 0.7.1 addresses some of these issues and we hope will fix many of the controller problems that some of our users are having.

[h1]How-To Guide on Setting up Controllers[/h1]
If you are having issues connecting controllers, go to the following forum on how to get Drink Inc setup for you. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/821230/discussions/0/1735468693686814607/]Go Here[/url]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Added XInput capability.[/b] 
Check the main menu->options to turn this ability on. Only turn this on if you have connection issues, or if you only have 4 users playing and want vibrations ːsteamhappyː
[*][b]Added Keyboard Controls (preliminary)[/b]
Keyboard controls are now available. We added this feature in early to help the users with controller issues. You are welcome to use the keyboard to play the game but we currently do not recommend it as the keyboard is not configurable. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/821230/discussions/0/1735468693686827470/]More on this here[/url]
[*]Fixed bug where Pizza character's face item would not show in game.
[/list]

[h1]COMING UP[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Profiles![/b]
The ability to save a profile and keep the same character layout each time. You can currently hit X to randomize if you don't feel like setting a player up but still want some change.
[*][b]Stats[/b]
Each profile will also have stats. Ex) how many times you died, how many drinks taken etc. Let us know if you have any stats you would like recorded. If it isn't too crazy of a stat, we would love to add it.
[*][b]Xbox Demo Release[/b]
We are finishing up the Xbox build and will be releasing the demo soon!
[/list]

Thank you guys and hope you continue enjoying Drink Inc! Please help us by reporting bugs. You can also give us feedback on what you'd like to see added to the game as well! We want our fans to be part of the development and make Drink Inc the best local party game ever.

notes.title: Early Access coming October 12th!
notes.content:
Drink Inc. will be available for Early Access this upcoming Friday (10/12/18). We are excited to work with all of you guys on making Drink Inc. the best couch party game possible! Any sort of feedback will help evolve the game and make it the way our fans want it to be. If you get the game, please report bugs, give input on gameplay, and let us know what you are looking for in a drinking party game! We want you guys to be involved in the development and that is why we are doing Early Access.

So, get ready and invite 7 of your friends over this next weekend to party it up with all of the mini games available.

notes.title: JULY UPDATE: New Language Support and More!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW LANGUAGES[/h1]
We added 11 new languages to the game so everyone around the world can enjoy. 

[h1]OTHER NEWS[/h1]
We have been making updates to the demo and you will see various release notes as new content is added! We are finalizing everything to get the game available as soon as possible so you guys can enjoy all of the content.

[h1]EARLY ACCESS?[/h1]
Would you like us to do Early Access? Here is a list below of certain elements of the game that would still not be fully finished if we did early access. As time goes on, more of the content below would be added and fixed.
[list]
    [*]Less Challenges
    [*]Fewer Store Content
    [*]Possibly bugs and glitches
    [*]Saved files could be lost as transitions/changes are made
[/list]

[h1]FEEDBACK[/h1]
Have any feedback or ideas? Let us know! We are open for suggestions and the sooner you let us know, the easier it may be for us to add it.

notes.title: STEAM, GET READY TO PARTY!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/f942d4a847157e9dc5f05e0a110987f7e0457dac.png[/img]

Hope you guys are excited as we are to release the first ever drinking video game! Built from the ground up with drinking content, this game features nothing but a bunch of ways to get the party started! We want to bring to you the best local party experience ever. There is no mode in our game that does not support 8 players. So, grab some friends and drinks for a unique party game like no other!

We value the community and will try to manipulate the final product in the next upcoming months to fit what the community is seeking! If you play the demo, free copy, or the beta, please give feedback and report bugs. This will make the gameplay more smooth and can even land you some rewards/deals! 

[h1] WHATS UPCOMING IN THE FUTURE:[/h1]

[b][u] Drink Inc. demo release[/u][/b]
The Drink Inc. demo will be released fairly soon! We mean like 1-2 weeks soon! 
[b][u] Beta testing[/u][/b]
After the demo has been out for a while and we continue to touch up the full game, we will release a beta to give you guys the full experience.
[b][u] Console Support[/u][/b]
Our goal is to also have support on one or two consoles. We will give more information as we go through the process of getting development rights. 
[b][u] Release date in the Winter?[/u][/b]
Right now our release date is set for Winter of 2018. More than likely, the full version will be released sooner. This is a worst-case release time in case issues were to occur. We will make announcements on if this changes!

[i] Have questions?[/i]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/821230/discussions/3/] Go here to ask any questions in our Q/A forum!
[/url]



We will continue to post new updates as we progress along the building process, thanks!


[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/1d4f9e06dced0b9fae21837d5e61a06591123efa.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32292586/2e0c455df4ec1ac6238cfd4dc41e28497897465c.png[/img][/url]
